poem.title: 静夜思
poem.author: 李白
poem.text: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。

user_prompt:
Translate this poem into literary English.
Title: 静夜思
Author: 李白
Genre: 五言绝句
Source:
床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。
translation:
**Quiet Night Thoughts**  
*Li Bai*

Before my bed, bright moonlight gleams;  
I wonder if it’s frost upon the ground.  
I raise my head to gaze at the bright moon,  
Then lower it and think of home.
